title: Lump Sum Funding in Horizon Europe: How does it work? How to write a proposal?
organiser: European Commission, DG Research and Innovation
summary: The Commission's simplification team explains how lump sum grants work and how to write a lump sum proposal, followed by a panel of beneficiaries with practical experience.
covers: How lump sum funding works in Horizon Europe
How to write a lump sum proposal
A panel discussion with invited guests on practical experience with lump sum grants
materials: Agenda, presentation slides and a pointer to the lump sum page of the Funding & Tenders Portal
why: Under a lump sum, payment depends on completing work packages, so the budget and the work plan have to be designed together from the start. Applicants to topics funded this way should review it before fixing their budget.
source_name: European Commission · Research and innovation community platform (related webinars)
